opening.argument: The opportunity is framed directly around earning money by selling photos online: the title promises “How To Sell Photos Online & Make Money,” and the description calls these the “Best places to sell photos online and make money 2021.” The supplied material then directs viewers toward named photo-selling destinations, including a Bigstock Photo page describing selling photos and earning money from sales, while other samples show buy-and-sell sections, social-posting options, and a PhotoShelter sign-in form with email and password fields. Together, these facts present a low-barrier path toward reward or asset acquisition through platform visits, account access, photo posting, or sales. The samples establish a promotional earning opportunity, but do not establish completed transactions, victim losses, or how any destination operates beyond the visible pages.
